title: TrustOperationEvidenceBundleV1
description: The supplied evidence a plan (plan.schema.json) is checked against to produce a report (report.schema.json). Frozen per issue #1714 checkpoint 1. v1 authenticates no external collector: it checks internal consistency against declared provenance only, and says so.

operation_id.description: Must match the bound plan's operation_id; a mismatch is invalid_evidence.

source.description: v1 ships no live collector; ordinary non-fixture runs never produce a caro_observed observation for file content. caro_observed is reserved for Caro's own existing process-result observation (e.g. exit status), not for a verified filesystem read.

snapshot_identity.description: Identifier binding this observation to a specific captured snapshot, used to detect stale or substituted evidence.

capture_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within this evidence bundle. Used for ordering only; not itself proof of freshness.

capture_time.description: RFC3339 timestamp if supplied. A timestamp alone never proves freshness.

destination_binding.description: Normalized destination this observation claims to describe. Must match the plan's normalized_destination or the observation is unbound.

context_binding.description: Context identity (cwd) this observation claims. Must match the plan's context_identity or the observation is unbound.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the observed raw bytes at this step, when content was captured.

authorization_claim.description: A supplied claim of approval. Data only; never itself an executor authorization token. See report.authorization provenance rules.

host_permission_claim.description: A supplied claim about host authorization. Never promoted to report.host_permission.state=granted with provenance other than supplied_claim.
